text_block_list.name: BC Live Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The BC Distaff is scheduled to start 
around 5:20, and the BC Turf around 
6:00――"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Early November. The time had come for this 
year's Breeders' Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Project "DREAMS," aimed two years into the 
future, did not account for entries this 
year or next. Perhaps due to this 
backdrop, there were no solo challengers 
either.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, even though today is a regular 
schedule despite the Breeders' Cup, I've 
been watching the broadcast since early 
morning to gather intel.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm scheduled to watch the broadcast 
together with Casino Drive after this, but 
attendance for other members is optional.
choice_data_list: Guess I should start heading over soon.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer-san. Fufu, you still 
look a bit sleepy.
choice_data_list:
The jet lag is forcing me to wake up 
early... *yawn*

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I went to bed early last night. 
Shall I brew some coffee to help wake you 
up?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Good mooorniiing♪ Man, it's so cold 
outside! Well, it's autumn, so what can ya 
do?
choice_data_list:
Good morning. You're here earlier than 
expected.

Good morning. You're here earlier than 
expected.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Well, in this world, information is 
everythingâª It's a must-have, absolutely 
a must.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Well, naturally there are a ton of races, 
so I'll have to catch up on the late-night 
broadcasts via archives, though.

text_block_list.name: BC Live Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The post time for the BC Turf is fast 
approaching, and the one to watch this 
year is none other than—"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, the resolution really is sharper on a 
bigger screen, huh.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Casino-san, are you brewing coffee by 
any chance? I'd love some too. Make it 
sweet♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, one way or another, the other 
members began gathering—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"By the time the BC Turf was set to start, 
everyone was gathered together."

text_block_list.name: BC Live Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"And they're off! A clean start for 
everyone. Now, taking the early lead is—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
! ...To think the battle for position 
right from the start could be that fierce.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Well, obviously. It's the race to decide 
the world's strongest, after all.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's on par with or better than the 
top tier in Japan right now. Every single 
race is a goldmine of info♪

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. But no matter who the opponent 
is, I will show you that I can overcome 
them.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa...! The global racing trends are 
completely overflowing with the name of 
the winning Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(The attention is really incredible after 
all. If I win this, Love-chan's dream will 
surely...)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it really is the perfect way to 
deliver love to the world~. I can't wait♡

text_block_list.name: BC Live Commentary
text_block_list.text:
""True to the style of American racing, 
the front-runners are pushing a blistering 
pace, turning this into a test of sheer 
endurance—""

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —...Tch. Are they all just monsters?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Does she seriously plan to keep that pace 
all the way to the finish...? If the 
chasers still have stamina left too, this 
could get pretty—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...A casino? You're making a tough face, 
did your stomach go bad or something?"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...! Ah, my apologies. I was just... 
reminiscing about the time of my own 
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, that last race was, 
if I recall...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...The BC Classic. It's the very same 
race I once ran in.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: To me, this race is—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
The starting point of a fresh start that 
leads to the present. And— the place I 
swore I would return to without fail.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"By birth, I come from—what you might call 
a prestigious lineage in the American 
racing world."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
A leg of the American Triple Crown, and 
the festival of GⅠs... the BC.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
As a child, I yearned for my family's 
dazzling legacy, etching their names as 
victors in such major races.

text_block_list.name: Former Casino
text_block_list.text:
"One day, I'll run in races too. And shine 
just like 'that person'... the pride of 
our clan...!"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
When I set my sights on racing, I was 
blessed with private tutors and began 
learning how to run from an early age.

text_block_list.name: Family Home Tutor
text_block_list.text:
I also remember the way that person ran, 
whom Casino Drive admires so much. Let's 
do our best!

text_block_list.name: Former Casino
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Family Home Tutor
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on winning the Junior 
Tournament. Haha, I couldn't be prouder!

text_block_list.name: Former Casino
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Sensei! With this, I'm sure—

text_block_list.name: Family Home Tutor
text_block_list.text:
"This is a memorable tournament where your 
sisters set records as well. I am sure 
they will be delighted to hear of it."

text_block_list.name: Former Casino
text_block_list.text: —...Yeah, you're right...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"I drew strength from my admiration and 
delivered results. Yet only then did I 
realize that the brilliance radiating from 
my older sisters was something that 
surpassed my own..."

text_block_list.name: Family Home Tutor
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! Between last year and this year, 
both sisters conquered the same Classic GⅠ 
race! Casino-san can't afford to fall 
behind either, then!

text_block_list.name: Former Casino
text_block_list.text:
(...I cannot let things stay as they are. 
No matter how much effort I pile on, no 
matter what results I achieve—)

text_block_list.name: Former Casino
text_block_list.text:
(...As long as my genius older sisters 
shine even brighter, I'll always remain 
hidden in their shadows.)

text_block_list.name: Former Casino
text_block_list.text:
(As long as I keep following the same 
path, this status quo will never 
change...)

text_block_list.name: Former Casino
text_block_list.text:
I have to change my approach! I have to 
change my environment!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! Leaving your hometown to forge 
your own path with nothing but your own 
strength is worthy of high praise! I have 
great expectations for you!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
(I have no reliable connections in Japan, 
but... from what I've researched, the 
training environment for athletes isn't 
bad.)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
(No Umamusume from Japan has ever 
conquered the American Triple Crown or the 
BC. This is my chance.)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
(Building strength and achievements from 
scratch— one day I will take on America's 
greatest races...!)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
(And a glorious radiance brighter than my 
sisters'... shining just like *that 
person*...!)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
(I will seize it. An American Dream of my 
very own, that only I can paint...!)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
(To fall out of shape right before the 
race I've dreamed of... What on earth... 
am I doing...?!)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Though it was beyond her control, she had 
to forfeit the big race where she was 
supposed to shine...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Even so, without giving up, I seized the 
next chance. The BC Classic, conquered by 
the senior I admired so much.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Now I can finally achieve that 
long-desired feat. Or so, I thought.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
What is this...? What is the meaning of 
this result...!? Did I really come all 
this way just to end like this—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I was being too hasty. My 
adaptation to the track conditions was 
also insufficient. However—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—It was an unmistakable setback. A very 
significant one for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I still remember watching that defeat on 
the broadcast. Her figure, standing alone 
under the sky of Santa Anita Park 
Racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"...So that's why you're trying again this 
time."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"The brilliance I sought to create within 
myself... Was it merely an illusion?"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Chasing the backs of the predecessors I 
admired. Cowering in the shadow of my 
exceptional older sisters.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
The value I sought to create for myself in 
a place beyond that prestige's reach is—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
The American Dream is “equality of 
opportunity”. It will come around time and 
again only for those who hold passion.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Never abandon your passion. Seek it out. 
Find the brilliance that only I, having 
known defeat at the BC, can bring forth!"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Think about why I lost—no... Why Japan has 
never managed a single victory up until 
now—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...The BC is where world-class Umamusume 
gather to compete, boasting more GⅠ titles 
than you can count on both hands.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Look to the turf, and Europe is packed 
with the world's best; look to the dirt, 
and the powerhouse America leads the 
fray...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
It is only natural for a powerhouse nation 
boasting many such mighty racers to 
dominate numerous races.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Unless they possess power overwhelming 
enough to dominate even world-class 
contenders—"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Without that, the chances of a lone 
challenger bearing fruit are infinitely 
close to zero."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Then—I just have to be the one to change 
it. Having keenly felt the need for Japan 
to change, I will do it myself.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—We will build a Team structure. A team of 
those who can compete on a world-class 
level.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"If you can pull that off, the path to 
victory will naturally open up for you."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Building a foundation to bridge the gap 
between Japan and the world's powerhouses. 
That's what "DREAMS" is for.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
If we can show a good chance of winning, 
we should be able to draw plenty of 
support from the URA as well, you see.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"We provide individual challengers with 
support systems and training environments. 
In return, the URA gets the chance to join 
the ranks of powerhouses in the BC. It's 
what you call a win-win."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“...Casino-san is paving the way right now 
for all the challengers yet to come, isn't 
she?”

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
There's no doubt about that. But on top of 
that— I also want to affirm my own value 
through this "DREAMS" project, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
To all who possess passion and strength, 
an equal chance. For some, it is only 
through training with a Team that their 
power to challenge the world might truly 
blossom.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
And if I can conquer the BC with the 
project I launched and pave the way for 
future generations—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Compared to a future of continuing 
sporadic, lonely challenges, isn't this 
tens of thousands of times more valuable?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Wow, how wonderful~! Creating a team just 
to help someone else achieve their dream!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: It truly is love, simply love...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Mr. Casino said he would use his own 
dream as fuel to help push my dream 
forward as well.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Like I said before, at its core, 
it's just confirming my own worth... I'm 
surprisingly calculating, you know.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
I think it's totally fine though~ Thanks 
to that, we get to be part of such a super 
hype project.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Heh, as long as I can aim for number one 
in the world, I'm down for whatever.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. This project is worth every bit of 
effort. In two years, I'll make sure they 
seize glory on that grand stage!
